title: CSV to rows
summary: Parse comma-separated text with a header into columns and rows.

sections.use: Turn CSV text with a header row into a table (columns and rows) for sorting, statistics or a Markdown table. Values stay exactly as written: 007 stays 007.
sections.exclusions: Comma-separated with a header only; edit the block for ; tab or | or for no header. Values are never trimmed or converted to numbers.
sections.limitations: Up to 1 MiB, 10,000 data rows, 200 columns and 10,000 characters a field. Standard quoting with doubled quotes. Blank lines are skipped and a leading byte-order mark is removed.
sections.missing_data: A header with no data rows gives an empty rows list.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.csv: The CSV text, first row the header.

outputs.out: The columns, the rows (lists of strings) and row_count.
